$comment: Gate regression scenario: the P1 launch state with one P1 rubrique (À propos) and one P1 domain (Éclairage public) closed. The routes exist and return 200 under p1, so the suite proves the gate itself — not a missing file — drives the 404. /carrières stays open like p1 but publishes no opening: the honest empty state (forms doc §4.9), and the legal utilities stay published (#28).
